title: Capstone: End-to-End ML Project
description: Take a real dataset from raw data to a served, evaluated model.
learningOutcomes: Run a full ML project lifecycle independently
Justify every modeling decision made along the way
Serve a trained model behind a real API

lessons.title: Framing the Problem
lessons.description: Turn a dataset into a well-posed supervised learning problem.
learningObjectives: Choose a target and success metric
Split data correctly before any exploration bias creeps in
Write down the baseline to beat

lessons.title: Modeling and Iteration
lessons.description: Baseline, iterate, and justify each improvement with evidence.
learningObjectives: Build and beat a naive baseline
Iterate using cross-validation, not the test set
Stop iterating for a defensible reason

lessons.title: Serving the Model
lessons.description: Wire the final pipeline into a FastAPI prediction endpoint.
learningObjectives: Load a persisted pipeline in a FastAPI app
Return a prediction with a confidence signal

lessons.title: Capstone Review
lessons.description: Evaluate the finished project against the original framing.
learningObjectives: Check the final model against the success metric
Identify the next real-world step (monitoring, retraining)
